feature_inventory.meaning: Player interaction inventory, not a percentage of code, routes or original-game parity. A linked test is not necessarily passing; consult the run report.

features.title: Start a campaign, select a profile and bring a saved hero
features.scope: Fresh and pre-start joins, campaign identity, Unicode names and incompatible save rejection.
features.remaining: First-run asset discovery, every intro movie and every legacy player save are not covered.

features.title: Move, run, crouch, steer and change camera direction
features.scope: Terrain/actor collisions, malformed inputs, script blocks, ownership, stamina, released input and posture.
features.remaining: No physical controller or touch device qualification; finite routes and authored maps.

features.title: Attack, aim, cancel a swing and change aggression
features.scope: Melee/ranged behavior, damage/body state, aim, recovery and queued spell priority.
features.remaining: Native unaimed hit-probability mismatches remain separately reported; no exhaustive combat sequence exploration.

features.title: Follow another actor or stop the current action
features.scope: Order replacement, follow-to-interact and interrupted actions.
features.remaining: Ordinary long-distance multi-companion follow formations are only partially covered.

features.title: Select and cast spells, wait for stamina
features.scope: Known-spell requirements, target disappearance, self targeting, resource waits, repeat effects and authority acknowledgements.
features.remaining: Every possible rune combination and spell/creature pairing is not covered.

features.title: Equip, remove and select weapons; fill and use the belt
features.scope: Slot capacity, worn-instance identity, equipment stats, belt weight, charges and replication.
features.remaining: Physical drag/drop across every screen size is not exhaustive.

features.title: Learn and remove spell objects
features.scope: Eight-slot capacity, duplicate objects, field refusal and persisted spell inventory.
features.remaining: Every school/complexity boundary combination is not covered.

features.title: Buy, sell and confirm exchanges
features.scope: Private purses, stock, exact copies, stale quotes, held transfers and quest-item restrictions.
features.remaining: Every merchant/quest-driven assortment change is not covered.

features.title: Repair damaged carried or bag equipment
features.scope: Batched cost, ownership, wear/charge conservation and repeated delivery.
features.remaining: No full path from every town entry to each repair menu.

features.title: Construct and dismantle equipment
features.scope: Nine recipe/material combinations per campaign, missing ingredients, invalid material, funds and special-item rejection.
features.remaining: Every legal material/enchantment recipe is not covered.

features.title: Build and dismantle spells
features.scope: Bag/shop/known-spell sources, fees, rune order, duplicate replies and paused guests.
features.remaining: No exhaustive rune Cartesian product.

features.title: Train skills and perks, remove ranks and reset training
features.scope: Cost order, dependencies, refunds, legacy credit, ownership, limits and partial/full reset.
features.remaining: Every progression route across a whole campaign is not covered.

features.title: Steal items, money or quest objects
features.scope: Actual approach/use completion, quest-first pockets, ownership, cancellation, dead/removed targets, equal skill and repeated loot.
features.remaining: Prepared actors and pockets; all scripted NPC theft reactions are not covered.

features.title: Collect corpses and stacked rewards
features.scope: Once-only collection, quest inventory, stack counts, private/shared bags and enchanted instances.
features.remaining: Every authored loot table and probability distribution is not exhaustively validated.

features.title: Revive fallen companions and retain their progression
features.scope: Revival policy, body state, retained experience and player camera.
features.remaining: Every death during a cinematic or chapter transition is not covered.

features.title: Use chests, doors, lifts and linked levers
features.scope: Usability, targeting, synchronized mechanisms, lift capacity, traversal and persistence.
features.remaining: Every mechanism in every campaign map is not covered.

features.title: Talk, select topics and close conversations
features.scope: Approach/staging, original topics, route completion and peer cues.
features.remaining: All dialogue branches, voice synchronization and every cinematic are not covered.

features.title: Accept and collect optional quest rewards
features.scope: Installed base side-quest archives, eligibility, duplicate acceptance/completion, once-only reward, touch UI and saves.
features.remaining: The expansion ships no .mq archives in this installation; no invented expansion side-quest fixture.

features.title: Travel between zones and preview destinations
features.scope: Campaign/peer destination state, reveal policy, tomb exit and island return. Direct exit confirmation/cancel, stale routes, death, owner permissions and once-only travel-time checks.
features.remaining: Not every entrance/exit pair is walked. Command-boundary fixtures record the final load; other transfer fixtures perform real world loads.

features.title: Pause and change simulation speed
features.scope: Host/guest permissions, shared time, saved clock and single-player rule selection.
features.remaining: Campaign pause presentation is not covered by the Arena-specific rendered lifecycle test.

features.title: Quicksave, quickload and select save files
features.scope: Authority, load generations, actor/effect references, spell consumption and menu choices.
features.remaining: Corrupt-file UI, disk-full handling and migration from all historical releases remain gaps.

features.title: Trigger, revisit and complete story objectives
features.scope: Native scripts, prerequisites, quest items, traps, repeated visits, captivity and chapter transition fixtures.
features.remaining: No exhaustive quest graph or uninterrupted full campaign playthrough.

features.title: Creature sensing, decisions, alerts and lifecycle
features.scope: Visibility changes, death/removal, help calls, aggression, spatial queries and late replicas.
features.remaining: Every creature motivation plus every authored NPC schedule is not covered.

features.title: Hide, become invisible or silent, escape pursuit
features.scope: Effects, perception, remembered targets, scripted pursuit and rendered-state eligibility.
features.remaining: All light/weather/terrain/sensing combinations remain open.

features.title: Locomotion, attack, cast, dialogue and loaded poses
features.scope: Authored clip/state/rig checks across both catalogues, moving attacks and pause/load transitions.
features.remaining: Most checks are headless state checks; they do not prove frame-perfect original pixels.

features.title: Spell visuals, attachments, particles and status expiry
features.scope: Origins/rigs, duration boundaries, overlap, timing, teardown and native/remake kernels.
features.remaining: Overall rendered effects quality, all GPUs and all visual combinations are not qualified.

features.title: Join, reconnect, change roles and return to solo play
features.scope: Real loopback ENet sessions, stable identity, private progress, copied parties, loss/reordering and checkpoint transport.
features.remaining: WAN latency, NAT, WebSocket/browser networking and cross-version peers remain gaps.

features.title: Recruit, switch chapters, manage pets and companions
features.scope: Equipment transfer, chapter roster changes, owner disconnect, pet identity and saved dependents.
features.remaining: No ordinary shop-available charm feature is implied by internal taming tests.

features.title: Read item/quest text, operate menus and load screens
features.scope: Rendered UI interactions and captures, tooltips, touch scrolling, effect timers and load cover.
features.remaining: Automated captures are not a manual accessibility/readability review of every screen.

features.title: Change controls, camera, graphics and profile preferences
features.scope: Navigation, apply/cancel, persistent preference keys and actual controls.
features.remaining: OS display switching, all monitor combinations and physical devices are not covered.

features.title: Use English, Russian and German
features.scope: Every remake option label/help/choice and catalogue formatting plus selected rendered localized controls.
features.remaining: Original text-archive languages and all dynamic line wrapping are not exhaustively tested.

features.title: Route sounds and change cave echo
features.scope: Routing/bus topology, immediate echo changes, cancel/apply and saved state.
features.remaining: Audio driver is Dummy and all volume preferences stay zero; audible fidelity and hardware output are not tested.

features.title: Recruit, buy, combine, deploy, fight and resolve Arena rounds
features.scope: Economy, capacity, alliances, quotes, draws, health, once-only settlement, saved opening and recovery.
features.remaining: All battle seeds, online multi-machine play, every board layout and long-run balance are not covered.

features.title: Install, enable, remove and exchange mods
features.scope: No configurations in this registered expansion.
features.remaining: Mod download, cancellation, migration, dependency resolution and multiplayer mismatches need their own isolated server fixtures.

features.title: Run on Windows, Android, browser and macOS
features.scope: Linux Godot 4.7 is the execution platform for this qualification.
features.remaining: Mobile lifecycle, browser storage/service workers, packaging and every rendering backend require platform-specific runs.
